approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Primary workflow scope currently stops only at another exact identifier of the same workflow type.
A later Submittal Response line changes an earlier RFI Question to MIXED, and a later RFI Status line can add a conflicting status to an earlier Submittal.
For a body-routed primary, stop role/status inheritance at the first different exact RFI or Submittal heading; retain established valid-Subject priority.
Secondary identifiers remain reviewable references and fragment locators; no semantic relationship or precedence is inferred.

642 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline; body-routed cross-type sections no longer manufacture linked RFI or conflicting Submittal state, while valid Subject routing remains compatible.
title: Stop cross workflow role and status leakage
objective: Prevent a later exact RFI or Submittal body section from donating role or status to a body-routed primary while preserving valid-Subject priority and every explicit section as evidence and references.
